response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), ref AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS m FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT g.brokrepstat, g.a, ref.m FROM g, ref WHERE g.a > ref.m) SELECT brokrepstat, a AS avg_modelconf, a - m AS above_overall_avg, a / (SELECT AVG(a) FROM q) AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of modelconf across all compliance cases with a non-null modelconf (a case-level average, not an average of the group averages). A status qualifies if its average is strictly greater than this value.
Cases with NULL brokrepstat form their own group, which appears as a NULL status. If the overall average is NULL, no rows are returned.
'How far above average' is the difference (status average minus overall average), not a percentage.

alternatives.interpretation: The reference average is the mean of the per-status averages (each status weighted equally) rather than the case-level average.
